fuel-quality-detection.pageTitle: Fuel Quality Detection System — Emad Ali Mohammed Hassan
fuel-quality-detection.problem1: The goal: detect fuel quality and adulteration with a portable device, by reading the sample's spectral signature and classifying it with a machine learning model.
fuel-quality-detection.problem2: Its engineering value lies in integrating several layers: hardware, embedded systems, software, data, machine learning, and edge AI.

contribution.c03: Built a portable fuel quality detection system.
contribution.c04: Integrated the AS7265X multispectral sensor (18 spectral channels).
contribution.c05: Worked with the ESP32 and the electronic components.
contribution.c07: Collected, prepared and analyzed the spectral data.
contribution.c08: Applied data preprocessing and feature engineering.
contribution.c09: Developed and evaluated machine learning models to classify fuel samples.

privacy.pageTitle: Privacy policy — Emad Ali Mohammed Hassan
privacy.description: What this site collects, how contact messages are stored, and your rights.
privacy.intro: This is a personal professional site. It collects as little data as possible, shows no ads, and uses no third-party trackers.
privacy.analyticsText: The site uses Umami, a privacy-friendly open-source analytics tool, to count visits and see which pages are read most. It uses no cookies, does not store IP addresses, and does not track you across other sites. The data is aggregate only: page, referrer, country, and device and browser type.
privacy.formText: When you send a message, the details you enter (name, email, subject and message) are stored with the message language in a protected Supabase database. Only I can read them; they are never shared and are used only to reply to you.
privacy.formSecurity: To protect the form from automated spam, the browser type and a one-way hash of your IP address are also stored. The address cannot be recovered from the hash, and it is used only to limit how many messages can be sent.
privacy.channelsText: If you contact me through WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Facebook or email, the conversation is covered by that service's own privacy policy.
privacy.hostingText: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may log technical data for security under its own policy. Fonts are served from this site, not loaded from external services.
